body: KanyeWest “YE” attended the ceremony on Chicago’s South Side honoring his late mother, Dr. Donda West, with the honorary street designation “Dr. Donda West Way.” Dr. West was a longtime educator and scholar at Chicago State University, where she chaired the English Department and founded the Gwendolyn Brooks Center. The intersection will now honor her decades of contributions to education, literature, and culture in Chicago. 🏾 W Chicago chicago.
